title: Maduro and wife plead not guilty to narco-terrorism charges
summary: Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores have pleaded not guilty to all charges during their first court appearance in their federal narco-terrorism case.
contentText:
Venezuela's Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores have pleaded not guilty to all charges during their first court appearance in their federal narco-terrorism case.

(Image credit: José A. Alvarado Jr. for NPR)
